items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: Yes, we got him in Albany.

ctx.x: That sounds like some of the stories I heard of people living out in Malibu and getting drunk.
After Slats Long there was Hank D'Amico?
Yes, we got him in Albany. He joined us in Syracuse; he was marvelous. Drank too much, killed him eventually.
